query: UPDATE candidate SET enrich='done',enrich_error=CASE WHEN json_array_length(enrich_changes)>0 THEN NULL ELSE coalesce((SELECT CASE WHEN status='needs_browser' THEN '需要浏览器：' || error ELSE '页面读取失败：' || error END FROM crawl_page WHERE candidate_id=?1 AND status!='success' ORDER BY status='needs_browser' DESC,kind='enrich_profile' DESC,id LIMIT 1),'页面上没有可补充的资料') END WHERE id=?1 AND review='pending' AND enrich IN ('queued','running') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crawl_page WHERE candidate_id=?1 AND work_state!='done')
